messages:
Maria R.: Heads up — StratusLabs wants a Dedicated commit for Q3 with a big seasonal spike. Need sizing + buffer policy. Anyone available?

Sanjay P.: Can you post their projected p95 throughput / latency requirements? Also region: AZ1 only?

Maria R.: They're in NA-west (AZ1). Proj: baseline 5k GPU-hours/mo, spike to 18k for 2 weeks in July. Model mix: 60% long-context chat, 40% embedding/rerank. Target p95 < 220ms for generation.

Kevin L.: Note: AZ1 still has intermittent NIC firmware issues; we throttle cross-AZ fallbacks. If we pin them to AZ1 we need local capacity buffer. I'd recommend ~25% headroom.

Jonas H.: Agree on headroom but prefer a tranche approach: reserved tranche + burst tokens. Example: reserve 8 A100-equiv GPUs steady, allow burst up to 12 for short windows via shared pool. Buffer policy: 20% guaranteed, 10% opportunistic.

Elaine (AM): Commercials: client wants a predictable monthly cap. Can we propose tiered pricing: reserved monthly + per-burst hour at 1.6x? I need numbers to show ARR impact.

Maria R.: Quick calc snippet (rough):
```
base_gpu_hours = 5000
spike_gpu_hours = 18000  # two-week spike
avg_monthly = (5000*2 + 18000)/3 = 9333
reserve_proposal = 9000
burst_headroom = 2000
```

Sanjay P.: reserve_proposal = 9000 looks sane. For perf we must account for long-context overhead — add ~15% effective GPU-hour multiplier for seq-len and KV warmups.

Jonas H.: Operational items: pre-warm kernel caches before the spike window, schedule canary traffic, enable aggressive prefix/KV caching for their top 50 prompts. Also network: validate upstream BGP paths in AZ1; ops-bot, please raise a ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-4823 – AZ1 NIC firmware remediation & BGP path validation. ETA initial triage 4h.

Elaine (AM): Client is asking for SLA on burst availability. Can we commit to 95% burst availability during the contracted spike if they accept a 30% uplift in monthly fee?

Kevin L.: 95% burst SLA is risky given AZ1 instability. We can offer 90% SLA or 95% SLA across multi-AZ; they insist on AZ1-only. Suggest 30% uplift and add a clause for "fallback to alternate model variant" during degraded network windows.

Maria R.: Draft proposal to send to customer: Reserve 9 GPUs (~9000 GPU-hrs), burst pool +2000 GPU-hrs billed @1.6x, 20% guaranteed buffer, 10% opportunistic buffer, SLA: 90% burst availability, with rollback & canary plan. I'll route to legal/accounting.

Elaine (AM): :thumbsup: I'll prep commercial terms. Sanjay/Jonas can you validate final numbers and ops checklist before EOD?

Sanjay P.: Will do. Also include quantization option (int8) for non-chat workloads — could cut GPU-hours by ~30%.

Jonas H.: I'll add the runbook checklist and pre-warm schedule to a PR in the ops repo and ping here when ready.
